decisions.summary: Probe shows the title screen with a Play button at screen_rect [490,380,300,64], three clock-hand nodes, and no scenario loaded. I will run three trials: (1) an ordinary title-to-menu navigation starting from the observed Play button rectangle, (2) a near_rewind scenario to exercise loop expiry/rewind within the 600-frame window, and (3) a near_victory scenario to exercise the exit-crystal completion path. All are fresh launches with empty user data and real inputs; checkpoint_frames are placed on the TrialPlan, not inside the trace.

trials.purpose: Ordinary launch: click the observed Play button (center ~640,412) to reach the chapter menu, allow menus to settle, attempt chapter/level selection, then basic movement/jump/interact inputs to capture the ordinary menu-to-game path.

Selected scenario near_rewind: confirm the game loads directly into level 1 with three recorded ghosts and the loop clock near the 30s boundary so the rewind/flash and a fresh ghost spawn are exercised within the 600-frame window. Capture scene state before and after the expected rewind based on actual observed behavior.

Selected scenario near_victory: confirm the game loads directly into level 1 with one recorded ghost and required switches held, then drive the player toward the exit crystal to observe whether completion fires and the Level Complete overlay appears with loop/time metrics. Records actual outcome without assuming success.

limitations: All three trials are freshly proposed in this turn and have not yet executed; no observations beyond the initial probe exist.
Screenshots are captured by the renderer but this text-only model has not visually inspected them; artwork/color claims are not made.
A 600-frame (20s) window cannot demonstrate a full 30-second loop from an ordinary level start, so R001 full-duration behavior is only partially exercised.
Near_rewind/near_victory scene contents are inferred from Developer scenario descriptions, not from observed state; actual behavior may differ.
Determinism (R028/R037) will only be assessable after the host performs fresh replays of these traces.

decisions.summary: All three proposed traces executed with fresh launches plus two fresh replays each (trials_left is now 0, so no further experiments are possible). (1) Ordinary title navigation: a mouse_click at the observed Play button rect center (640,412) advanced Main/TitleScreen to Main/ChapterMenu, which showed 'Select a Level', a Back button, four chapter labels (Amber, Teal, Magenta, Pale Gold) with six level buttons each, and only Chapter 1 'Level 1' enabled (level 1 button screen_rect [678,130,300,36]); the other 23 entries read as locked. My later clicks used guessed coordinates (300,360 then 300,300) rather than that rect, so the trace stayed in ChapterMenu through frame 599 and never reached gameplay. (2) near_rewind loaded directly into Main/Level as 'Loop 4 / 4' with three ghost Area2D nodes; the 30.00 timer counted down, a flash (flashing=true, flash_timer ~0.333) with tick reset was observed, existing ghosts restarted playback at frame 0 and a new ghost spawned at the spawn point. After that, the recorded player fell off the ground platform and position y grew to ~34000 with sustained downward velocity; no respawn occurred. (3) near_victory loaded into Main/Level with one ghost and switches_held {s1: true}, but the player ran and jumped off the platform (y ~29000) and never touched the exit crystal, so the Level Complete overlay stayed hidden and exit_at_time stayed 0.0. Replay determinism: near_rewind and near_victory matched state and pixel hashes across both fresh replays; title_nav_probe did not match in either replay, with the first pixel difference at frame 0 (title clock hands animate on wall clock) and state divergence at frame 0 as well. No requirement is marked verified and no QA verdict is given; that the ordinary click that hit the Level 1 button would enter the level is inferred, not confirmed.

findings.description: Ordinary launch reached the chapter menu: a mouse_click at the observed Play button center (640,412) changed current_screen from Main/TitleScreen to Main/ChapterMenu. The menu shows Heading 'Select a Level', a Back button (40,660,160,48), and four chapter labels each followed by six level buttons; only 'Level 1' (Main/ChapterMenu/Panel/Grid/@Button@4, screen_rect 678,130,300,36, disabled=false) is enabled and the other 23 show '(locked)' and disabled=true. Consistent with R007/R008 at the node-text level.
findings.uncertainty: Only node text and rects were observed; menu legibility and art were not visually inspected by this model.

findings.description: My ordinary navigation trace missed Level 1: after entering ChapterMenu I clicked guessed points (300,360 then 300,300), but the observed Level 1 button screen_rect is [678,130,300,36]. The scene stayed Main/ChapterMenu at frames 120, 240, 450 and 599, so ordinary gameplay was never reached. This is a trace-targeting miss, not evidence of a game bug.
findings.uncertainty: Not retried because the trial budget was exhausted; clicking the exact observed rect is expected to work but was not confirmed.

findings.description: near_rewind loaded straight into Main/Level (menus skipped) with three ghosts (Main/Level/Ghost, @Area2D@11, @Area2D@12) and HUD 'Loop 4 / 4' with timer '30.00'. By frame 180 a rewind/flash cycle was observable: flashing=true with flash_timer ~0.3333, tick reset to 0, the ghost node list rotated and a new ghost @Area2D@16 appeared at the spawn, and existing ghosts jumped to playback_frame 0 then advanced with tick. This is textual evidence of flash + rewind + ghost-replay-on-restart behavior consistent with R002/R011/R030.
findings.uncertainty: Whether the new ghost reproduces the prior loop frame-for-frame exactly is inferred from positions/playback_frame, not independently validated; no visual inspection.

findings.description: In near_rewind and near_victory the player left the ground platform and kept falling with no recovery: positions reached y ~10966 (near_rewind frame 500), y ~34033 (near_rewind frame 599), y ~2654 to ~29004 (near_victory) with large persistent downward velocity (e.g. 5020, 8980, 8280). No respawn or death behavior occurred within the 600-frame window, leaving the player unrecoverable off-screen. Level 1 platforms are only [[0,540,1280,40],[1120,420,160,24]] with spawn [96,480], suggesting an open bottom to the world.
findings.uncertainty: May be intended open-bottom level design without fall-death, or missing out-of-bounds handling; not confirmed visually or with an intentional fall test.

findings.description: near_victory loaded straight into Main/Level with one ghost and switches_held {s1: true} at frame 0, timer '30.00', 'Loop 1 / 4', matching the scenario intent that the required switch is held. However the player ran and jumped off the platform and never contacted the exit crystal at [1180,400], so completed stayed false, CompleteOverlay visible_in_tree stayed false, and exit_at_time stayed 0.0. A later loop did rewind (at frame 599, 'Loop 3 / 4' with two ghosts), showing repeated rewind behavior.
findings.uncertainty: Completion did not fire because the exit was never touched, so exit-gating and metric display are unconfirmed rather than shown broken.

findings.description: Deterministic replay comparison: near_rewind and near_victory each had state_match=true and pixel_match=true across both fresh replays, matching their capture. title_nav_probe had state_match=false and pixel_match=false in both replays with first differing pixel and state at frame 0, consistent with the title-screen clock hands being driven by wall-clock time.
findings.uncertainty: The frame-0 title mismatch is most plausibly wall-clock animation but is not proven; divergent scene progression could also contribute.

findings.description: Not exercised: ghost-held switches/pressure plates, doors, laser blocking, enemy distraction, reset button clearing ghosts, the Level Complete overlay values, later chapters/scenarios (level_complete, reset_flow, level_1_single_ghost, level_2_two_loop, level_3_three_loop, final_chapter), and ESK/menu return. No behavioral claim is made for these.
findings.uncertainty: No traces exercised these mechanics, so any claim about them would be unfounded.

findings.description: In-level HUD nodes present during near_rewind/near_victory play: TimerLabel (16,8,184,44) reading '30.00' counting down, LoopLabel (210,14,210,32) reading 'Loop N / 4', ResetButton (1080,8,184,40), MenuButton (900,8,164,40), a controls HUDNote, and Timeline marker ColorRects under Main/Level/HUD/Root/Timeline/Markers that grew in count as ghosts appeared. Node presence is consistent with R001/R009/R014 config but appearance was not visually inspected.
findings.uncertainty: Observed from node text/rects only; not visually confirmed and not validated frame by frame against the intended 30 s window.

limitations: trials_left is 0, so the missed Level 1 click and a controlled drive to the exit crystal could not be retried.
This text-only model did not visually inspect any screenshot; all observations come from parsed scene-tree text and rects.
The ordinary title-to-level path never entered gameplay because of the coordinate miss; ordinary in-level movement/jump/interact was not demonstrated.
A 600-frame (20 s) window cannot show a full 30-second loop from an ordinary level start; rewind was only exercised via preloaded scenarios.
Ghost interaction with switches/plates/doors/lasers, enemy distraction, reset behavior, and the level-complete overlay remain unverified.
No requirement is marked verified and no QA verdict or score is asserted; findings are model interpretations with stated uncertainty.
The title-screen replay pixel/state mismatch is plausibly harmless wall-clock animation but is not proven.
